_comment: TASK-1003 F-10a — the cross-language contract fixture for POST /api/v1/internal/stt/streaming/usage. `pushback` is the exact wire body `apps/stt/src/stt/core/api_client/gateway.py::record_streaming_usage` sends: `{**summary, interrupted}`, where `summary` is `SessionManager._build_teardown_summary()` (apps/stt/src/stt/streaming/session_manager.py) and `interrupted` is the one field gateway.py adds on top. It carries every top-level key the summary builder returns plus `interrupted`, and one `segments[]` entry with every key `UsageSegment.to_dict()` (apps/stt/src/stt/streaming/usage_segments.py) emits. Both halves read this SAME file: apps/api/src/modules/internal/__tests__/stt-streaming-usage.contract.test.ts (the DTO, `SttStreamingUsagePushbackRequest`, must accept it whole under the global ValidationPipe's whitelist+forbidNonWhitelisted+forbidUnknownValues) and apps/stt/tests/unit/contracts/test_streaming_usage_contract.py (a REAL summary built through `_build_teardown_summary` must carry exactly this key set, and its one segment exactly the segment key set — minus `interrupted`, which the summary itself never carries). Change either producer's field set and update this fixture in the same commit, or one half goes stale silently.
